name: backend-architecture
description: Audit and design backend services against rules across 13 technical areas, or look up a single area's rules. Audit defaults to a triage of the top risks; a full audit adds a coverage inventory and scored report; design records assumptions, decisions and validation. Domain review is opt-in.

interface.shortDescription: Backend audit, design and rule lookup across 13 technical areas
interface.longDescription: Three skills: backend-audit (a triage of the top risks by default, --full for the scored protocol with coverage inventory and readiness), backend-design (requirements arithmetic, an assumptions registry, decisions and a validation plan) and backend-rules (one to three areas' rules for a pattern question or a short snippet). Domain review is opt-in with --domain on.
defaultPrompt: Audit this service for the top backend risks.
How should I make these webhooks idempotent?
